aria-invalid.zh-CN: 原生 input 的 `aria-invalid`；`validateStatus` 为 `error` 时固定为 `true`。
aria-invalid.en-US: `aria-invalid` of the native input; fixed to `true` when `validateStatus` is `error`.

aria-labelledby.zh-CN: 原生 input 的 `aria-labelledby`。未设置、没有 `aria-label` 且渲染了 `insetLabel` 时，指向该标签。
aria-labelledby.en-US: `aria-labelledby` of the native input. When it is not set, there is no `aria-label` and an `insetLabel` is rendered, it refers to that label.

addonBefore.zh-CN: 前置标签，可以是文本、Semi 图标或任意 `ReactNode`。
addonBefore.en-US: Addon before the input: text, a Semi icon or any `ReactNode`.

addonAfter.zh-CN: 后置标签，可以是文本、Semi 图标或任意 `ReactNode`。
addonAfter.en-US: Addon after the input: text, a Semi icon or any `ReactNode`.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 清除按钮的图标，`showClear` 为 `true` 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Icon of the clear button, effective when `showClear` is `true`.

composition.zh-CN: 是否开启输入法模式，开启后输入法组合期间不触发 `onChange`，组合结束后触发一次。
composition.en-US: Whether to enable IME mode; `onChange` does not fire during a composition and fires once after it ends.

defaultValue.en-US: Initial content when the input is uncontrolled.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用。在 InputGroup 中未设置时，使用组的 `disabled`。
disabled.en-US: Whether the input is disabled. Inside an InputGroup, the group's `disabled` applies when it is not set.

getValueLength.zh-CN: 自定义计算字符串长度，搭配 `maxLength`、`minLength` 使用，例如把 emoji 按可见长度计算。
getValueLength.en-US: Custom string length calculation, used with `maxLength` and `minLength`, such as counting an emoji as one character.

hideSuffix.zh-CN: 清除按钮显示时隐藏后缀，默认两者并列。
hideSuffix.en-US: Hides the suffix while the clear button is shown; by default the two sit side by side.

inputStyle.zh-CN: 原生 input 元素的内联样式。
inputStyle.en-US: Inline style of the native input.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 内嵌标签，未设置 `prefix` 时渲染在前缀位置。
insetLabel.en-US: Inset label rendered in the prefix position when `prefix` is not set.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: `insetLabel` 所在元素的 `id`，供 `aria-labelledby` 引用。
insetLabelId.en-US: The `id` of the element around `insetLabel`, for `aria-labelledby` to reference.

mode.zh-CN: 输入框模式，可选 `password`，显示密码显隐按钮。
mode.en-US: Input mode: `password` shows a button that reveals or hides the text.

onBlur.zh-CN: 输入框失去焦点时的回调。监听在外层 `div` 上，焦点在输入框与组件内按钮之间移动时不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the input. It listens on the wrapper `div`, so focus moving between the input and the buttons inside the component does not fire it.

onChange.zh-CN: 输入内容变化时的回调，参数为新值与事件；点击清除按钮清空时也会触发。
onChange.en-US: Called when the value changes, with the new value and the event; clearing with the clear button also triggers it.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

onEnterPress.zh-CN: 按下回车时的回调（keydown），输入法组合中确认的回车不触发。
onEnterPress.en-US: Called on Enter keydown; the Enter that commits an IME composition does not fire it.

onFocus.zh-CN: 输入框获得焦点时的回调。监听在外层 `div` 上，组件内部的焦点移动不会再次触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when the input gets focus. It listens on the wrapper `div`, so focus moving inside the component does not fire it again.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: keydown 回调，参数为原生事件。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called on keydown with the native event.

onKeyUp.zh-CN: keyup 回调，参数为原生事件。
onKeyUp.en-US: Called on keyup with the native event.

onlyBorder.zh-CN: 外层 wrapper 的边框宽度，单位 px；`style` 中的同名值会覆盖它。
onlyBorder.en-US: Border width of the wrapper, in px; a `borderWidth` in `style` overrides it.

placeholder.zh-CN: 输入框为空时显示的提示文字。
placeholder.en-US: Hint text shown while the input is empty.

prefix.zh-CN: 前缀标签，可以是文本、Semi 图标或任意 `ReactNode`。
prefix.en-US: Prefix: text, a Semi icon or any `ReactNode`.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动文档，作用于 `focus()` 方法（未传 `options.preventScroll` 时）。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing avoids scrolling the document; applies to the `focus()` method when `options.preventScroll` is not given.

readonly.zh-CN: 是否只读：禁止输入，且不显示清除按钮。原生 `readOnly` 只禁止输入。
readonly.en-US: Read-only: blocks typing and hides the clear button. The native `readOnly` only blocks typing.

ref.zh-CN: 命令式句柄（`InputHandle`），成员见 **Methods** 表。
ref.en-US: Imperative handle (`InputHandle`); its members are in the **Methods** table.

showClear.zh-CN: 输入框有内容且悬停或焦点位于组件内时展示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Shows a clear button when the input has content and the pointer or focus is inside the component.

showClearIgnoreDisabled.zh-CN: 内部属性，供 DatePicker 使用：禁用时仍可清除。
showClearIgnoreDisabled.en-US: Internal prop used by DatePicker: the clear button stays available while disabled.

size.zh-CN: 输入框大小，可选 `large`、`default` 或 `small`。在 InputGroup 中未设置时取组的 `size`。
size.en-US: Input size: `large`, `default` or `small`. Inside an InputGroup it takes the group's `size` when not set.

style.zh-CN: 外层 wrapper `div` 的内联样式。

suffix.zh-CN: 后缀标签，可以是文本、Semi 图标或任意 `ReactNode`。
suffix.en-US: Suffix: text, a Semi icon or any `ReactNode`.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 `default`、`error` 或 `warning`；`error` 时输出 `aria-invalid` 为 `true`。

value.zh-CN: 输入框内容，受控使用，配合 `onChange` 更新。
value.en-US: Content of the input, used as a controlled value together with `onChange`.

focus.zh-CN: 获取焦点。未传 `options.preventScroll` 时，使用 `preventScroll` 属性的值。
focus.en-US: Focuses the input. The `preventScroll` prop applies when `options.preventScroll` is not given.

select.zh-CN: 选中输入框中的全部文本。
select.en-US: Selects all the text in the input.

setSelectionRange.en-US: Sets the selection, with the parameters of the native `setSelectionRange`.

input.zh-CN: 原生 `input` 元素。每次读取返回当前挂载的节点，卸载后为 `null`。
input.en-US: The native `input` element. Each read returns the node mounted now, and `null` after unmount.

nativeElement.zh-CN: 组件根元素，即外层 `div`。卸载后为 `null`。
nativeElement.en-US: The root element of the component, the wrapper `div`. `null` after unmount.

autosize.zh-CN: 高度是否随内容自适应。传入 `{ minRows, maxRows }` 可限制行数，`minRows` 缺省时取 `rows`。
autosize.en-US: Whether the height follows the content. Pass `{ minRows, maxRows }` to limit the rows; `minRows` defaults to `rows`.

cols.zh-CN: 可见宽度，按平均字符宽度计。
cols.en-US: Visible width in average character widths.

composition.zh-CN: 是否开启输入法模式，开启后输入法组合期间不触发 `onChange`，组合结束后触发一次。
composition.en-US: Whether to enable IME mode; `onChange` does not fire during a composition and fires once after it ends.

defaultValue.en-US: Initial content when the textarea is uncontrolled.

disabledEnterStartNewLine.zh-CN: 内部属性，供 Chat 使用：Enter 不换行，Shift + Enter 换行。
disabledEnterStartNewLine.en-US: Internal prop used by Chat: Enter does not start a new line, Shift + Enter does.

getValueLength.zh-CN: 自定义计算字符串长度，搭配 `maxLength`、`minLength` 与 `maxCount` 使用。
getValueLength.en-US: Custom string length calculation, used with `maxLength`, `minLength` and `maxCount`.

lineNumberClassName.en-US: Class name of the line number area.

lineNumberStyle.en-US: Inline style of the line number area.

maxCount.zh-CN: 字数上限，设置后显示字数统计；超出时计数器标红，但不截断输入，需要限制输入时搭配 `maxLength`。
maxCount.en-US: Maximum number of characters; setting it shows a counter, which turns red when exceeded. The input is not truncated; use `maxLength` to limit input.

onBlur.zh-CN: 失去焦点时的回调。监听在外层 `div` 上，焦点在文本框与清除按钮之间移动时不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the textarea. It listens on the wrapper `div`, so focus moving between the textarea and the clear button does not fire it.

onChange.zh-CN: 文本内容变化时的回调，参数为新值与事件。
onChange.en-US: Called when the text changes, with the new value and the event.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

onEnterPress.zh-CN: 按下回车时的回调（keydown），输入法组合中确认的回车不触发。
onEnterPress.en-US: Called on Enter keydown; the Enter that commits an IME composition does not fire it.

onFocus.zh-CN: 获得焦点时的回调。监听在外层 `div` 上，组件内部的焦点移动不会再次触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when the textarea gets focus. It listens on the wrapper `div`, so focus moving inside the component does not fire it again.

onInput.zh-CN: 原生 `input` 事件的回调，直接绑定在 `textarea` 元素上。
onInput.en-US: Called on the native `input` event, bound to the `textarea` element.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: keydown 回调，参数为原生事件。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called on keydown with the native event.

onKeyUp.zh-CN: keyup 回调，参数为原生事件，直接绑定在 `textarea` 元素上。
onKeyUp.en-US: Called on keyup with the native event, bound to the `textarea` element.

onResize.zh-CN: 尺寸变化回调：`autosize` 导致高度变化时触发；用户拖拽 `resize` 调整尺寸时也会触发，并额外给出 `width`。
onResize.en-US: Called when the size changes: when `autosize` changes the height, and when the user drags the resize handle, which also provides `width`.

placeholder.zh-CN: 文本框为空时显示的提示文字。
placeholder.en-US: Hint text shown while the textarea is empty.

readonly.zh-CN: 是否只读：禁止输入，且不显示清除按钮。原生 `readOnly` 只禁止输入。
readonly.en-US: Read-only: blocks typing and hides the clear button. The native `readOnly` only blocks typing.

ref.zh-CN: 命令式句柄（`TextAreaHandle`），成员见 **Methods** 表。
ref.en-US: Imperative handle (`TextAreaHandle`); its members are in the **Methods** table.

resize.zh-CN: 是否允许用户拖拽调整尺寸及方向，可选 `none`、`both`、`horizontal`、`vertical`、`block`、`inline`。仅在显式传入时生效，`autosize` 开启时忽略。
resize.en-US: Whether and in which direction the user may resize: `none`, `both`, `horizontal`, `vertical`, `block` or `inline`. It takes effect only when given, and is ignored with `autosize`.

showClear.zh-CN: 文本框有内容且悬停或焦点位于组件内时展示清除按钮；不可编辑时不显示。
showClear.en-US: Shows a clear button when the textarea has content and the pointer or focus is inside the component; hidden when it is not editable.

showCounter.zh-CN: 是否显示字数统计；设置 `maxCount` 时总是显示。
showCounter.en-US: Whether to show the character counter; it is always shown when `maxCount` is set.

textareaStyle.zh-CN: 内部 `textarea` 元素的内联样式，如高度、背景色。
textareaStyle.en-US: Inline style of the inner `textarea` element, such as its height or background color.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 `default`、`error` 或 `warning`；`error` 时输出 `aria-invalid` 为 `true`。

value.zh-CN: 文本内容，受控使用，配合 `onChange` 更新。
value.en-US: Text content, used as a controlled value together with `onChange`.

select.zh-CN: 选中文本框中的全部文本。
select.en-US: Selects all the text in the textarea.

setSelectionRange.en-US: Sets the selection, with the parameters of the native `setSelectionRange`.

textarea.zh-CN: 原生 `textarea` 元素。每次读取返回当前挂载的节点，卸载后为 `null`；切换 `showLineNumber` 会重新挂载它。
textarea.en-US: The native `textarea` element. Each read returns the node mounted now, and `null` after unmount; toggling `showLineNumber` remounts it.

nativeElement.zh-CN: 组件根元素，即外层 `div`。卸载后为 `null`。
nativeElement.en-US: The root element of the component, the wrapper `div`. `null` after unmount.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用，组内任意深度未自行设置 `disabled` 的控件取这个值。
disabled.en-US: Whether the group is disabled; controls at any depth in the group that set no `disabled` of their own take it.

label.zh-CN: 组的标签，对象形式，属性同 `Form.Label`，如 `text`、`required`、`extra`；`text` 可以是 `ReactNode`。
label.en-US: Label of the group, as an object with the `Form.Label` props such as `text`, `required` and `extra`; `text` can be a `ReactNode`.

onBlur.zh-CN: 组内任一控件失去焦点时的回调，组内控件之间移动焦点也会触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when any control in the group loses focus, including a move to another control in it.

onFocus.zh-CN: 组内任一控件获得焦点时的回调，组内控件之间移动焦点也会触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when any control in the group gets focus, including a move from another control in it.

ref.zh-CN: `role="group"` 元素的引用。带 `label` 时仍指向该元素，而不是外层容器。
ref.en-US: Reference to the `role="group"` element. With a `label` it still points to that element, not the outer container.

size.zh-CN: 输入框大小，可选 `large`、`default` 或 `small`；组内任意深度未自行设置 `size` 的控件取这个值。
size.en-US: Input size: `large`, `default` or `small`; controls at any depth in the group that set no `size` of their own take it.
